title: Shinonome Ena — Secondhand Ticket〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, it's a quarter till...
I should log in to Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Then, we can pick this conversation back up when Enanan gets here... Oh...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, look who it is! Good timing♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I thought I heard my name just now...
Were you talking about what we'll be working on today?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <We were talking about tickets for the Bridal Fair.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah! The Phoenix Bridal Fair!
They're apparently bringing it back!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Remember? K invited us the last time around.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You and K were invited by Honami after she received some tickets from Emu, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I actually received another ticket for this year, but I need to go visit my dad...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My dad is coming over this weekend...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I see...
Yeah, that does sorta take priority.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I also received a ticket, but I've got work and this anime event I've really been wanting to go to. Total overlap.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We were just talking about how it'd be a shame to have our tickets go to waste.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Which reminded us of you!
You couldn't go last time because you had art class that day.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hang on. Does this mean you're giving me your ticket?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Bingo!
I'll post the schedule for it in chat now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Thanks, I'll take a look.
Let's see... Can I go...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, these days should work for me!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <At least one of our tickets will get used now!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<But the three of you aren't free, right?
That means I'd be going by myself.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, K, do you think Honami would be interested in going again?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, I'd imagine so...
She apparently also received some tickets.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But she said she was going to try inviting Hoshino and the others...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, that's the thing.
Emu can't go this time around.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, she sounded really sad.
She even asked me if I knew anyone that'd be interested.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, they came to mind for a second, but I doubt either of them will be free...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <When I messaged them a little while back, they said their weekends are all booked up for work.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Dang. There goes your short list of friends. Who does that leave? Li'l Bro?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Excuse me? My list of friends is much longer than that.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still, Futaba's about the only person left who I can invite...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Oh, that reminds me...
Mr. Yukihira gave us that assignment about depicting different textures.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wedding dresses would definitely be good practice, so it could be worth visiting by myself to take a bunch of pictures for reference.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, you there? Don't clam up on us now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I'm not.
I was reminded of this assignment I have to do for art class.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, I might take this opportunity to go by myself and take a bunch of pictures to use as reference.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The last time we went, they had a ton of dresses on display, so they should help you a lot!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Right. I honestly couldn't believe how many they had there.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Really? I'm sorta looking forward to going now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know! Why don't I give you my ticket when we're at school? Unfortunately, I have to go tomorrow, so I'll wait for you to get there.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? But you'd have to wait until the evening.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Not a problem♪ The teachers are gonna force a pile of worksheets on me, so I'll pass the time doing those.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Pass the time...? Don't cut any corners, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, you're right.
It's 25:00, so let's get started.>
